issue.title: Remove legacy plaintext AI credentials on RN web's first launch
issue.body:
## What

Older shipping web builds stored AI credentials in plaintext localStorage under `splotch-ai-user-api-key` and `splotch-ai-access-token`. When the RN web app launches over such a browser profile, it leaves both keys in place, readable by any script on the origin. Shipping web removes them on boot (it moves them into its encrypted vault).

## Why

`docs/migration/WEB-CONTRACT.md` requires abandoned-credential security on web and PWA fresh initialization. It must "remove/invalidate known abandoned sensitive entries or retain them only behind a reviewed protection/risk disposition, without exposing or reactivating them".

Not migrating these keys is settled cutover data loss. Leaving the plaintext behind is not: an OpenAI API key stays in localStorage on every cut-over device.

## Where

- `experiments/native-architecture/src/ai/session.ts`, `ai/credentialLease.ts` and `platform/aiVault.web.ts` (ledger row L0154).
- Shipping's handling: `web/src/lib/state/aiKey.ts` and `state/aiAccessToken.ts`. The key names come from `web/src/lib/storageKeys.ts` (`legacyAiUserApiKey`, `legacyAiAccessToken`).

## Repro (rn-web, Chromium)

1. At 00fcc5c78d1031873db1a214301c008daa4bd080, build and serve the RN web export.
2. Before the first load, put `localStorage['splotch-ai-user-api-key'] = 'sk-proj-…'` and `localStorage['splotch-ai-access-token'] = 'legacy-access-code'` on the origin, as a shipping-era profile would have them.
3. Load `/` and wait 3 s.
4. Expected: both keys gone (shipping: none remain). Actual: both remain.

Evidence: AI-1 record, cell `ai-legacy-plaintext-credentials` (`docs/scratchpad/2026-10-18-device-parity/results/ai-1-web-2026-10-19.md` on branch `claude/rn-web-parity-cloud`).

## Done when

- RN web's first launch deletes, or overwrites and deletes, both legacy plaintext keys without reading them into use. A reviewed disposition recorded in WEB-CONTRACT is the alternative.
- A test seeds both keys and asserts they are gone after boot.

Refs #2978
